label: 🌐 NetCDF
description: Read NetCDF files (.nc, .nc4, .cdf) — climate / oceanography / earth-science data with named dimensions and variables. Reads via xarray; flattens to a long-format table with one row per cell and one column per coordinate + the variable's value. Use the 'variable' option to pick which data variable to load. Requires the [science] extra.

variable.label: Variable name
variable.help: Which data variable to load. Default: the first variable in the file. The variable's coordinates become columns alongside the value.
